- Finance admin. Take payments, raise invoices, prepare monthly statements, chase what is outstanding and check supplier invoices

- Experience in a front-of-house, reception or patient/customer coordination role, ideally in a private healthcare, dental, hospitality or members' club setting

- Highly organised: able to run several diaries, trackers and processes at once without dropping anything
- Looks ahead and takes ownership. Chases things through to completion without being asked
- Confident with technology: practice management systems, CRM, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, email and spreadsheets

- Understands confidentiality and GDPR and applies it instinctively
- Full UK driving licence and own car (business mileage is paid)

Desirable
- Experience in a private GP, dental or clinic setting, or with a practice management system such as Semble
- Experience selling or promoting a membership or subscription service
- Experience coordinating suppliers, contractors or small projects
- Familiarity with social media content or community outreach

Hours, location and pay
- Hours: 25 to 45 hours a week. Part-time or full-time, with the option to grow the hours over time. We are flexible on the pattern for the right person. Some weekend work is involved
- Location: Surrey Heath / Berkshire border. Based at our main practice site, with a monthly visit to our second site and occasional travel to collect supplies
- Salary: £26,000 to £28,000 full-time equivalent, pro rata for part-time hours, depending on experience
- Benefits: Business mileage paid at 45p per mile. Full training on all practice procedures. A small, close team working directly with the CEO
- Start: As soon as possible
- Requirements: Right to work in the UK. Full UK driving licence. An enhanced DBS check will be required

How to apply
Send a CV and a short covering note explaining why this role suits you. Please include one example of a time you took ownership of a problem and saw it through to the end.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview with the Medical Director, followed by a short practical exercise on the day.

- Previous experience in credit control, bookkeeping, accounts administration or a similar all-round accounts role.
- A good understanding of bookkeeping principles, ledgers, payments and account reconciliations.
- Experience chasing outstanding debts and communicating confidently with customers about payments.
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to maintaining accurate financial records.

As one of the first points of contact for our patients, you will play an important part in ensuring they receive a friendly, professional and caring service. Duties will include welcoming patients, handling enquiries, managing appointments and providing essential administrative support to the wider Practice team. We pride ourselves on our friendly, close-knit working environment, where teamwork, mutual support and a personal approach are valued. You will be joining a dedicated team who work together to make a real difference to our patients and local community. If you enjoy working with people, have excellent communication and organisational skills and are looking for a rewarding role within a friendly and supportive team, we would love to hear from you! Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice including the provision of secretarial and clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Duties and Responsibilities : The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the practice administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager/Deputy Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Opening up/locking-up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointments system Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team member and associated healthcare agencies and providers Clearing and re-stock consulting rooms as required Providing clerical assistance to practice and Trust staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning Ordering, re-ordering and monitoring of stationery and other supplies Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required; loading and emptying the dishwasher and keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy Keeping the reception area, notice-boards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Undertake training/mandatory training as required. To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures. To work in accordance of written protocols. Be able to cover reception as necessary. Registrations of new patients computer data entry and medical records. Process patients change of address (have knowledge of Practice area). Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours. Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm. Confidentiality : In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters.
